claim: Uganda's Ebola outbreak will be formally declared over on or about 27 August 2026
resolution_criteria: WHO or Uganda MoH issues a formal end-of-outbreak declaration by 5 Sept 2026

claim: The US State Department will NOT lower Uganda from Level 4 within 30 days of the outbreak being declared over
resolution_criteria: State Dept Uganda advisory still Level 4 thirty days after the WHO declaration

claim: Kenya peak-season arrivals hold up despite political rhetoric discouraging visitors
resolution_criteria: August 2026 arrivals at or above August 2025 (277|155) per Tourism Research Institute or ministry data

claim: Nairobi hotel occupancy or ADR comes under measurable pressure as ~1|500 branded rooms open in 2026
resolution_criteria: Published Nairobi occupancy or ADR for H2 2026 below the equivalent 2025 period

claim: Zanzibar branded all-inclusive supply growth pressures independent resort rate benchmarks
resolution_criteria: Evidence of independent Zanzibar resorts cutting published rates or reporting allocation loss into 2027

claim: Regional airlift into East Africa continues expanding faster than rate discipline can absorb
resolution_criteria: Net seat capacity into NBO/EBB/ZNZ/KGL up year-on-year while published lead-in rates flat or down
